card.name: Punctuation before essential oil and herb lists
card.fires_on: Colons and commas right before or within a list of herbs or essential oils, such as chamomile, lavender, peppermint, thyme. Also the word fresh before an herb in a recipe.

modes.label: Colon before oil list
modes.description: A colon after a health purpose, followed by a list of essential oils.
modes.example: and marjoram Decongestant and Antihistamine<<:>> peppermint and ginger To Encourage

modes.label: Comma between herbs
modes.description: A comma inside a list of herb or oil names.
modes.example: E.O.’s to use: To reduce Bronchial Spasms: chamomile, lavender<<,>> rose, geranium and marjoram

modes.label: Fresh before herb
modes.description: The word fresh just before an herb name in a recipe ingredient list.
modes.example: 2 bay leaves 4 sprigs<< fresh>> thyme 1 pound Yukon Gold

card.plain: It marks the spot where a list of aromatherapy oils or herbs is about to continue.
